avis.titre: Hydrating, non sticky, no niacinamide included. ⭐️
avis.texte: If you’re someone with sensitive skin, a compromised barrier, or skin that gets irritated easily, the KAINE Kombu Barrier Ampoule is a standout option that truly lives up to its calming reputation. One of the biggest reasons this serum works so well for reactive skin is that it does not contain niacinamide. While niacinamide is a great ingredient at around 5% (and sometimes up to 10% for more resilient skin), it’s often added to everything—cleansers, toners, serums, and moisturizers. That layering can unknowingly push your total exposure far too high, which is a common cause of irritation, redness, and stinging for sensitive skin types. This ampoule avoids that issue entirely, making it an excellent choice for people who want hydration and barrier support without the risk of niacinamide overload. The formula is led by kombucha (fermented black tea) as the main ingredient, which provides antioxidant benefits and helps soothe stressed skin. It’s supported by panthenol (pro-vitamin B5) and glycerin, both well-known for calming irritation and deeply hydrating the skin, along with propanediol and water to improve moisture retention and overall skin feel. These ingredients focus on strengthening and comforting the skin rather than aggressively treating it, which is exactly what sensitive or compromised skin needs. In terms of texture, the ampoule is slightly viscous and a bit thick at first, but it absorbs surprisingly fast. It dries down non-sticky, layers beautifully under other

avis.titre: Exotic ingredients, absorbs fairly quickly. Beautiful packaging. High quality.
avis.texte: It seems that just about every novel ingredient you could imagine is being worked into skincare serums these days - this particular example employs kombucha, which is a fermented tea and a wildly popular drink loaded with health benefits. But will those benefits somehow translate to healthier looking skin? This Korean beauty serum has a Greek name (we are told, Kaine means "new"!). It's very nicely packaged and I love the frosted glass, sort of square shaped bottle - it's lovely and sophisticated looking. Inside, this serum is milky and light amber in color and completely odorless. This has one of those familiar dropper bulbs which I like because I can precisely measure out how much product I'm dispensing. The serum is viscous. That means it's not overly watery or runny. Drop it on a vertical surface and it takes a while to roll. So it's thick, but not overly so. If a serum is too thick, it has trouble absorbing - too thin, and it usually soaks in fast, but lacks hydrating properties we look for in this type of product. This one strikes a good balance between the two. For a fairly viscous serum however, it does soak in and dry fairly quickly, though. I like that with a daytime serum because I am typically shorter on time during my morning routine. This will be a morning serum for me. The serum feels nice. I didn't experience any particular sensations to note - no tingle or burn - just a pleasant hydrating/moisturizing effect. This formula has 5% panthenol, which I LOVE and it

Don't like the flavor of kombucha? That's okay, let's just put it on our faces! That was my thinking when I ordered this Kombu Barrier Ampoule from Kaine. The formulation for this serum contains 73% kombucha, and that is a good thing because kombucha does a lot of great things for the skin. It can exfoliate and brighten the complexion, it's an anti-inflammatory and will soothe, it provides good hydration, repairs and strengthens the moisture barrier and it will promote the production of collagen and elastin. They didn't stop there though, this serum also contains plenty of other skin loving ingredients to help keep a complexion looking its best. These ingredients include 8 different types of hyaluronic acid, 5% panthenol, 1% ceramide and Allantoin. It's a very good formulation. The solution is on the thicker side when first applying it but it quickly thins out when massaged into the skin. After application there was no stickiness or any residue, just softer skin. The color is cloudy and since there is no fragrance added, there is no noticeable scent. I've been using this Ampoule for about a week now and am liking it a lot. It has not been long enough for any truly noticeable benefits, but I have noticed that my pores are less noticeable, my skin overall looks less red (from rosacea), and most of the flakiness is gone. I am very happy with this product and I'm looking forward to seeing what other benefits might be derived from continued use. Currently it is selling for $22. It

This facial serum from KAINE is quite gentle on my face and layers well with my other serums. It's quite powerful and I found it changed my skin texture from dry and red with lots of splotchy rough areas so very soft without a red mark in sight. It pairs well with most moisturisers and I find it isn't sticky. Drydown time was around ten minutes so keep that in mind before moving on to the next step of skincare. As always, wear sunscreen in the day as your last step. Overall, I recommend this and would likely reorder.
This product has done wonders for my face, I’ve gotten many compliments saying my skin is glowing.

After moving to Florida, I developed a pretty stubborn case of dermatitis and was desperately searching for something that would help soothe and repair my skin without being too heavy or clogging my pores. This serum honestly exceeded my expectations — it’s lightweight, non-sticky, non-greasy, and feels incredibly calming on irritated skin. It absorbs beautifully, doesn’t cause breakouts, and my skin feels much more balanced and hydrated since I started using it. For the price, it’s an absolute gem. Highly recommend to anyone with sensitive or compromised skin!

avis.titre: Moisturizing and not stickyMoisturizing and not sticky
avis.texte: This Ampoule serum by Kaine is nicely packaged in my opinion. It looks like a more expensive product than it actually is. This serum, unlike most has a slight tint of color to it that goes on the skin clear. It is very similar to the thin consistency of a typical serum, but, a tiny bit thicker. It does feel a bit sticky at first, however, once Applied to the skin it seems to absorb nicely and does not leave a sticky finish. I had never tried kombucha on my skin before, but I know it has many health benefits when ingested so I thought it would be nice to give it a go. I can’t say that I have noticed any dramatic effects or differences after using this ampoule, but it feels nice going on my skin and leaves it feeling moisturized and fresh. This is a serum I could wear either at night to layer with some of my other skin care products, or in the day even underneath make up. Overall, I’m pretty happy with this skin care Serum

The serum feels light, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling. It’s gentle, making it good for sensitive skin. After using it for a while, skin feels softer, smoother, and more hydrated. I've never used anything with kombucha so it was pleasant surprise. The packaging is soo good. Plus, it’s vegan and cruelty free, which is a bonus for those who prefer clean beauty products!
